items.text: Research Kenyan law: Data Protection Act 2019 (ODPC), Consumer Protection Act 2012, Electronic Transactions Act, Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, tourism and short-let rules, payments and KRA tax
Read the app's actual data, payments, consent and privacy implementation to compare against the law
Write compliance report with required adjustments and features to build
Verify the report covers the required Kenyan areas and lists actionable fixes
